_about: Reviewed findings of tools/audit_integrity.py --check t12: how the tests, the verification code,
the examples and the support metadata changed between the baseline commit and the audited commit.
Each finding id is the audit's; verdict is justified or violation. evidence, quote and moved_to
are checked by the audit: text must be in the named file of the audited commit, in the baseline
commit's file (BASE:path) or in a commit message (a hash). A loosened, changed or removed
tolerance, and a removed tolerance check, needs the quoted reasoning. pre_work_failures lists the
tests that failed or errored in the recorded pre-work run; each must still exist, or its rename
must be recorded. tests/test_audit_integrity.py fails on an unreviewed finding or a stale entry.
pre_work_record: BASELINE_FAILURES.md and baseline_*.json of the workspace, recorded before the work at an earlier commit; not part of this repository.

skip:tests/gui/test_developer_screens_br.reason: New browser test (gui-marked, deselected by default); the skip names Playwright, which the test extra does not install, the same reason the baseline's workbench browser test gives.

skip:tests/test_a_missing_compiler_or_ot.reason: New test helper; skips only when the shell whose wording it tests (bash or dash) is absent, because the compile line is run through that shell.
New test marked abaqus (deselected by the offline suite); the skip names a missing licensed Abaqus.

New test; skips when OTILib's Python build is not importable (an external GPL build, not on PyPI). Its counterpart without the runtime, test_the_oti_backend_refusal_says_no_runtime_was_found_and_what_to_do, runs everywhere. UMAT has no RUN_OTILIB_TESTS switch, so this skip stays a skip even in the clean-clone run if OTILib is not importable.

skip:tests/test_contract_packaging.py:te.reason: Stricter than the baseline: the baseline skipped on any wheel-build failure; now a build failure is an assertion, and the only skip left is for a missing setuptools, which the test extra declares.

removed_check:src/umat_oti/validation/pa.reason: The column-scaled maximum-error plateau checks against FD_TOLERANCE were replaced by a verdict per entry against centred differences of the ORIGINAL over a step ladder: every entry of DSIGMA_DP, DSTATEV_DP and DDSDDE agrees, is consistent with zero, is unresolved, or disagrees; any disagreement raises, and every array needs an agreeing column.
